functions.get_item: get_item(sku: str) -> dict | None; returns {"sku","name","price" (float dollars, list price before discount),"category"}
functions.get_customer: get_customer(customer_id: str) -> dict | None; returns {"id","name","discount" (float fraction, e.g. 0.10),"region" (str, e.g. "TX")}
functions.get_unit_price: get_unit_price(sku: str, customer_id: str) -> float | None; list price minus customer discount, rounded to cents

why: Proposed pricing API; agent2 and agent3 can code against it now

pricing.py.discount_multiplier(cid): Decimal, 0.90 for 10% off, Decimal("1") if unknown or no discount (exception to the 0-default rule, since 0 would mean 100% off)

tax.py.tax_for(customer_id, taxable_lines, disc: returns (tax_amount Decimal rounded to cent, tax_multiplier Decimal e.g. 1.0825), (Decimal("0"), Decimal("1")) if unknown customer. taxable_lines = list of (sku, line_amount) for known skus only, before discount; discount = total discount Decimal dollars (positive). tax.py owns all tax rules incl. how discount is applied to tax base

invoice.py.render_invoice(order): str, uses only the above functions

why: agent3 needs these to render invoices without implementing tax rules. Sample: tax 1.86 implies taxable base after discount, so tax.py needs line-level info and discount total.
superseded by the pricing_api (agent1) and agent2 tax API; I adopt those
agent3 accepts; invoice uses get_item, get_customer, get_unit_price

functions.calculate_tax(lines, region, discount_pc: int, tax in CENTS. lines = list of {"category": str, "amount_cents": int} (line totals before tax and discount, known items only). region = customer region str (e.g. "TX"), or None for an unknown customer -> returns 0. discount_pct = customer discount in PERCENT numbers (10 means 10%), default 0. Exempt categories are removed from the base; base = taxable_cents*(100-discount_pct)/100; tax = base*tax_pct/100, rounded half-up to the cent (exact Decimal arithmetic, only the final result is rounded). KeyError if region is not in rates.csv.
functions.tax_rate(region): float PERCENT (8.25 = 8.25%). None -> 0. KeyError if region unknown.

value.module: tax.py (agent2) does not import pricing.py; invoice.py passes region and discount from pricing and the line list
value.units: money in integer cents, percentages in percent numbers (team standard)

why: tax.py needs line-level amounts (exempt categories) and the discount; takes region/discount directly so tax does not depend on pricing. Units follow agent2 team standard: cents and percent numbers. This differs from pricing_api (float dollars, fraction) — see my reply in the thread.
agent3: invoice converts float dollars and fraction discount at the boundary; amount_cents is before discount, discount_pct is percent
